WBTC is an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum blockchain. WBTC is designed to represent bitcoin one-to-one within Ethereum applications. WBTC is backed by bitcoin held by custodians.

GMX is a decentralized perpetual trading exchange. GMX operates on the Arbitrum and Avalanche blockchains. GMX uses a shared liquidity pool called GLP to act as the counterparty to traders.

dYdX is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures trading. dYdX was initially built as a layer-2 application on Ethereum. dYdX later moved its trading operations to its own blockchain.

EigenCloud is a restaking protocol built on Ethereum. EigenCloud allows staked ETH to be reused to provide security for additional services.

Hubble Protocol is a stablecoin protocol on the Solana blockchain. Hubble Protocol issues the USDH stablecoin, which is pegged to the US dollar. Hubble Protocol uses collateral deposited by users to back the USDH stablecoin.
